name: Rohit Prakash Gawade
bio: Rohit Prakash Gawade is a passionate technologist specializing in graphic design and cyber security, with extensive experience in community contributions. He has actively participated in several renowned tech communities, including Google Developer Groups Pune, Flutter Pune, Foss United Pune, AWS Pune, and Ubucon Asia’24, where he created impactful event materials and managed large-scale events. Rohit has worked on innovative projects like a CNC Plotter for PCB Design, a Network Jamming Device, and Virtual Environment Integration in Arch Linux. With a strong foundation in networking, desktop engineering, and digital forensics, combined with professional experience as a System Admin, UI/UX Designer, and Team Lead, Rohit blends technical expertise with creativity to drive solutions.

name: Shubham Rane
community_title: Advanced App Engineering Analyst at Accenture
bio: Shubham is working as Advanced Application Engineering Analyst at Accenture Solutions Private Ltd. His work aligns closely with Data Engineering principles, enabling him to build and manage efficient and scalable data pipelines. He possesses a strong skillset in Python, SQL, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Power BI, and Machine Learning, allowing him to tackle complex data challenges. Committed to professional development, he is currently pursuing an MTech in Data Science and Engineering from the prestigious BITS Pilani and actively volunteers as a Content Team Lead with GDG Pune for over 2 years. His dedication to the field is reflected in his membership of the International Association of Engineers (IAENG).
